$ edit b/corpus_test.go  # a package b over the corpus
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # poke
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    script/error/transform/poke: Adds do/out/p.txt.
        poke failed on the base: poke: the base is too big
        Fix its jenny, or make its probe decline such a base.
    script/flat/transform/poke: Adds do/out/p.txt.
        poke made a variant an archive can't hold:
          transform/poke/in/flat: an input belongs in a tree, as transform/poke/in/<tree>/<file>
        Fix its jenny: what it makes is the variant's whole input view, with the trees as its top-level directories.
    script/marker/transform/poke: Adds do/out/p.txt.
        poke made files an archive can't hold:
          do/out/m.txt: its line 2 is shaped like a section marker, which starts another section when the archive is read
        Fix its jenny.
    script/nest/transform/poke: Adds do/out/p.txt.
        poke made an input view no file tree holds: it holds tr/nest, and tr/nest/x below it.
        Fix its jenny.
    script/panic/transform/poke: Adds do/out/p.txt.
        poke panicked on the base: boom
        Fix its jenny.
    script/probe-no/transform/poke: poke declines the base: the base is too small
    script/probe-none/transform/poke: Adds do/out/p.txt.
        poke's probe said the base isn't for it, and gave no reason.
        Fix the probe: when it says no, it says why.
    script/probe-panic/transform/poke: Adds do/out/p.txt.
        poke's probe panicked on the base: probe boom
        Fix the probe.
    script/same/transform/poke: Adds do/out/p.txt.
        poke made an input view equal to the base's. A variant changes the base.
        Make its probe decline such a base.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script

the base is too big

accepted

accepted
